## Summary

A clear description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Who benefits?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature in detail. Include any technical approach if you have one.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you considered and why you prefer this one.

## Component

- [ ] Smart contract (USSTMine / EscrowUSDT)
- [ ] Miner client
- [ ] Explorer / DEX / Faucet UI
- [ ] Bridge relayer
- [ ] Infrastructure (Docker, CI)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Additional Context

Any mockups, references to similar features in other projects, etc.
